title: Entropy Nomenclature Collision: SYN-062's rho(ENT)=+0.90 is SPECTRAL Shannon entropy; EMP-191/201/231's rho(ENT)=-0.90 is RECURRENCE (RQA) entropy
dataset: colony_lib.datasets neural_eeg (fs=128 Hz, 14 channels, 5 canonical bands delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma)
verdict: NOT a pipeline (m,tau,eps) artifact and NOT Simpson/channel-pooling. It is a METRIC-NAME COLLISION.

cross_correlation_of_band_profiles.note: spectral-ENT and recurrence-ENT band profiles are ANTI-correlated across frequency

evidence_2_simpson_channel_pooling_ruled.conclusion: pooling does NOT flip the sign -> Simpson's paradox is NOT the cause

evidence_3_eps_dependence_discriminator.conclusion: RQA ENT is eps-DEPENDENT, so SYN-062's claim 'rho(ENT)~+1.0 invariant across (m,tau,eps)' is false for recurrence ENT; only the SPECTRAL entropy is genuinely eps-free/invariant.
